# Project

Create a REDCap database named **Diabetes Triage**.

The supplied Stata dataset is:

`dr-triage-002.dta` — Diabetes Registry Triage Dataset, 19 July 2026.

It contains 1,537 records and 20 variables. The Stata dataset includes variable-level metadata, labels and formats; please review and use these when constructing the REDCap data dictionary.

# Record identifier

Create a new REDCap record identifier using the prefix **`REG`**, with records in the form:

```text
REG-000001
REG-000002
```

This REDCap identifier is separate from all identifiers imported from the Stata dataset. 

# Initial data import

The project team will provide the Stata-derived import dataset containing the existing 1,537 records.

## Source data dictionary

The following is the full data dictionary supplied from Stata. The Stata variable-level metadata should be reviewed when constructing the REDCap data dictionary.

| Variable | Stata storage type | Stata display format | Stata value label | Variable label | REDCap role |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `eid_emis` | float | `%9.0g` | — | EMIS ID from EMIS software | Import; review and complete; editable |
| `eid_jh` | float | `%9.0g` | — | EMIS ID from Jacqui Henry spreadsheet | Import; informational; read-only |
| `eid_aset` | float | `%9.0g` | — | EMIS ID from ASET software | Import; informational; read-only |
| `iid_stata` | float | `%9.0g` | — | Internal ID from Stata analytics | Import; informational; read-only |
| `iid_aset` | float | `%9.0g` | — | Internal ID from ASET software | Import; informational; read-only |
| `iid_jh` | float | `%9.0g` | — | Internal ID from Jacqui Henry spreadsheet | Import; informational; read-only |
| `prefix` | str14 | `%14s` | — | Name prefix (Mrs, Mr, etc) | Import; informational; read-only |
| `fname` | str40 | `%40s` | — | First Name | Import; informational; read-only |
| `mname` | str15 | `%15s` | — | Middle Name | Import; informational; read-only |
| `lname` | str40 | `%40s` | — | Last Name | Import; informational; read-only |
| `flname` | str29 | `%29s` | — | Firstname[space]Lastname - used for fuzzy matching | Import; informational; read-only |
| `name_clean` | str45 | `%45s` | — | Full name with standard spacing, before split into components | Import; informational; read-only |
| `sex` | float | `%9.0g` | `sex_` | Patient sex | Import; review Stata coding; read-only unless agreed otherwise |
| `dob` | float | `%dD_m_CY` | — | Date of birth - used for fuzzy matching | Import; informational; read-only |
| `phone1` | str10 | `%10s` | — | Phone number 1 | Import; review and complete; editable |
| `phone2` | str10 | `%10s` | — | Phone number 2 | Import; review and complete; editable |
| `email` | str10 | `%10s` | — | Email | Import; review and complete; editable |
| `vital_status` | float | `%9.0g` | — | Alive; deceased; unknown | Import; review and complete; editable |
| `date_of_death` | float | `%9.0g` | — | Date of death | Import; complete if applicable; editable |
| `residence_status` | float | `%9.0g` | — | Resident in St Helena | Import; review and complete; editable |

The source dataset has the following variables:

```text
eid_emis       eid_jh          eid_aset        iid_stata
iid_aset       iid_jh          prefix          fname
mname          lname           flname          name_clean
sex            dob             phone1          phone2
email          vital_status    date_of_death   residence_status
```

# Fields requiring review or completion

The St Helena review team will check and, where necessary, complete or correct:

| Variable | Requirement |
|---|---|
| `eid_emis` | Review and complete. This is currently the key patient identifier in the St Helena Health Directorate. |
| `phone1` | Review and complete where available. |
| `phone2` | Review and complete where available. |
| `email` | Review and complete where available. |
| `vital_status` | Review and complete. |
| `date_of_death` | Complete where applicable. |
| `residence_status` | Review and complete, including overseas residence or migration where applicable. |

All other imported variables are informational and should be read-only for the review team.

# Review completion

Add a small review section at the end of the instrument containing:

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `review_status` | Record whether the record is `Unverified`, `Reviewed — no changes required`, `Reviewed — changes made`, or `Unable to verify`. |
| `reviewer_name` | Identify the person who completed the review. |
| `review_date` | Record the date of review. |
| `review_notes` | Optional explanation of unresolved issues or important changes. |

The review team should be able to select **Unverified** until a record has been reviewed. The remaining review fields should be completed when the review status changes from `Unverified`.

# Change history

Please use REDCap’s native logging/audit-trail functionality to retain the field-level history of changes, including the previous value, new value, user and date/time. The review fields above should record the review outcome; the REDCap audit trail should record what was changed.

No separate before-and-after variables are required.

# Points requiring local confirmation

Please review the Stata metadata and confirm the final coding for:

- `sex`;
- `vital_status`; and
- `residence_status`.

The residence coding must be capable of distinguishing, where relevant, St Helena residence, temporary overseas residence, permanent migration overseas, and overseas medical care.
